  "contentsAfterEdit": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"\n在 ACDC (来自 ABD 预处理数据) 上运行 Conv-LoRA + SAM + GSPO + Adapter 的\n半/弱监督训练与推理脚本。数据准备需先运行 prepare_acdc_conv_lora.py。\n\n相较 run_acdc_conv_lora.py，这个脚本额外支持：\n- semi_labeled_fraction / semi_labeled_seed：只用一部分样本的精确掩码，剩余样本用弱监督盒约束\n- weak_box_* / weak_loss_*：弱监督盒生成与约束超参\n- gspo_allow_semisup：在半监督时允许 GSPO 仅对有标签子集启用\n\"\"\"\nimport argparse\nimport os\nimport time\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nimport torch\nfrom autogluon.multimodal import MultiModalPredictor\nfrom PIL import Image\n\n\ndef expand_path(df: pd.DataFrame, dataset_dir: str):\n    df = df.copy()\n    for col in [\"image\", \"label\"]:\n        df[col] = df[col].apply(lambda p: os.path.join(dataset_dir, p))\n    return df\n\n\ndef visualize_samples(predictor: MultiModalPredictor, df: pd.DataFrame, vis_dir: str, max_samples: int = 8):\n    \"\"\"\n    仅保存前 max_samples 个验证样本的预测掩码，避免磁盘爆炸。\n    会覆盖同名文件，文件数量固定。\n    \"\"\"\n    from PIL import Image\n    os.makedirs(vis_dir, exist_ok=True)\n    subset = df.head(max_samples).copy()\n    try:\n        preds = predictor.predict(subset)\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"[VIS] predictor.predict failed: {e}\")\n        return\n    \n    # preds 对于语义分割是一个 list of numpy arrays\n    if isinstance(preds, list):\n        for idx, (_, row) in enumerate(subset.iterrows()):\n            if idx &gt;= len(preds):\n                break\n            mask = preds[idx]\n            if mask is None:\n                continue\n            mask_arr = np.array(mask, dtype=np.uint8)\n            if mask_arr.ndim == 3:\n                mask_arr = mask_arr.squeeze()\n            img_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(row[\"image\"]))[0]\n            out_path = os.path.join(vis_dir, f\"{img_name}_pred.png\")\n            Image.fromarray(mask_arr).save(out_path)\n        print(f\"[VIS] Saved up to {len(subset)} predicted masks to {vis_dir}\")\n    elif hasattr(preds, \"columns\") and \"semantic_mask\" in preds.columns:\n        for i, row in subset.iterrows():\n            mask = preds.loc[i, \"semantic_mask\"]\n            if mask is None:\n                continue\n            mask_arr = np.array(mask, dtype=np.uint8)\n            img_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(row[\"image\"]))[0]\n            out_path = os.path.join(vis_dir, f\"{img_name}_pred.png\")\n            Image.fromarray(mask_arr).save(out_path)\n        print(f\"[VIS] Saved up to {len(subset)} predicted masks to {vis_dir}\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"[VIS] Unexpected prediction format: {type(preds)}; skip visualization.\")\n\n\ndef compute_fg_macro_dice(predictor: MultiModalPredictor, df: pd.DataFrame, num_classes: int = 4):\n    \"\"\"\n    前景宏平均 Dice：对每个前景类 (1..num_classes-1) 分别计算二值 Dice，再取平均。\n    ABD/ACDC 的 test 脚本口径：若某类预测像素全为 0，则该类 Dice 直接记为 0；\n    否则按标准 Dice 计算（即便 GT 该类为空，Dice 也会是 0）。\n    \"\"\"\n    eps = 1e-6\n    dices = []\n    preds = predictor.predict(df)\n    for idx, (_, row) in enumerate(df.iterrows()):\n        gt = np.array(Image.open(row[\"label\"]))\n        pred = np.array(preds[idx])\n        for c in range(1, num_classes):\n            gt_c = (gt == c)\n            pred_c = (pred == c)\n            # 与 ABD &#96;test_ACDC.py&#96; 一致：只要 pred 该类为空，就直接记 0\n            if pred_c.sum() == 0:\n                dice_c = 0.0\n            else:\n                inter = np.logical_and(gt_c, pred_c).sum()\n                union = gt_c.sum() + pred_c.sum()\n                dice_c = (2 * inter + eps) / (union + eps)\n            dices.append(dice_c)\n    if not dices:\n        return 0.0\n    return float(np.mean(dices))\n\n\ndef main():\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"ACDC semi/weak-supervised semantic segmentation with Conv-LoRA + GSPO + Adapter\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--dataset_dir\", type=str, default=\"datasets/acdc_conv_lora/acdc_conv_lora\",\n                        help=\"由 prepare_acdc_conv_lora.py 生成的数据集根目录\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=1337)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--rank\", type=int, default=3)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--expert_num\", type=int, default=8)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--num_gpus\", type=int, default=1)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--output_dir\", type=str, default=\"outputs/acdc_conv_lora_semi\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--ckpt_path\", type=str, default=None, help=\"若只做评估，指定已训练模型路径\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--per_gpu_batch_size\", type=int, default=1)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--batch_size\", type=int, default=4, help=\"有效 batch size；若大于 per_gpu_batch_size*num_gpus，则会做累积\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--eval_only\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"只做评估，不训练\")\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--eval_split\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"test\",\n        choices=[\"train\", \"val\", \"test\"],\n        help=\"eval_only 时评估的数据划分：train / val / test（train 表示在训练集上做评估）\",\n    )\n    # GSPO\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_enable\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_group_size\", type=int, default=4)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_warmup_epochs\", type=int, default=5)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_contrastive_weight\", type=float, default=0.1)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_quality_momentum\", type=float, default=0.9)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_allow_semisup\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"半监督时允许 GSPO 只在有标签子集上启用，弱标子集跳过 GSPO。\")\n    # GSPO-Adapter 扩展\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_adapter_enable\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"启用 GSPO 对 Encoder Adapter 的质量反馈\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_adapter_momentum\", type=float, default=0.9,\n                        help=\"GSPO Adapter 质量历史的动量项\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_adapter_scale_adaptation\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"启用基于质量历史的自适应缩放\")\n    # Adapter\n    parser.add_argument(\"--adapter_enable\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--adapter_dim\", type=int, default=64)\n    # 可视化配置\n    parser.add_argument(\"--vis_samples\", type=int, default=8,\n                        help=\"训练结束后从验证集可视化的样本数（固定覆盖，不额外增长）\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--vis_output_dir\", type=str, default=\"outputs/acdc_vis_semi\",\n                        help=\"可视化输出目录\")\n    # Training epochs control\n    parser.add_argument(\"--max_epochs\", type=int, default=100, help=\"Maximum training epochs\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--patience\", type=int, default=30, help=\"Early stopping patience (set large to disable early stopping)\")\n    # Loss function\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loss\", type=str, default=\"mask2former_loss\",\n                        choices=[\"dice_ce_loss\", \"mask2former_loss\"],\n                        help=\"Loss function: mask2former_loss (recommended for SAM multi-class) or dice_ce_loss\")\n    # Mask tokens\n    parser.add_argument(\"--num_mask_tokens\", type=int, default=10,\n                        help=\"Mask tokens/queries (建议 &gt;= 类别数，Mask2Former 风格推荐 10+)\")\n    # Semi / weak supervision\n    parser.add_argument(\"--semi_labeled_fraction\", type=float, default=0.1,\n                        help=\"使用精确掩码的样本比例，其余仅用弱监督盒约束\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--semi_labeled_seed\", type=int, default=123,\n                        help=\"划分有/无精确掩码子集的随机种子\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_box_jitter_mode\", type=str, default=\"box\", choices=[\"box\", \"image\", \"pixel\"],\n                        help=\"弱监督盒的抖动模式\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_box_jitter_amount\", type=float, default=0.1,\n                        help=\"弱监督盒的抖动幅度\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_box_outward_only\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"弱监督盒仅向外扩张，不收缩\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_loss_outside_weight\", type=float, default=1.0,\n                        help=\"盒外背景约束权重\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_loss_entropy_weight\", type=float, default=0.05,\n                        help=\"盒内熵最小化权重\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_loss_tv_weight\", type=float, default=0.0,\n                        help=\"盒内平滑 (TV) 约束权重\")\n    # Quick / Debug\n    parser.add_argument(\"--debug\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"仅处理少量样本以快速验证\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--quick_test\", type=int, default=None, help=\"仅处理前 N 个测试样本\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)\n\n    # 初始化 wandb（确保已登录）\n    # 说明：\n    # - AutoGluon/Lightning 默认用 TensorBoardLogger 记录训练与验证指标；\n    # - 用 wandb 的 sync_tensorboard 能稳定同步曲线，无需触碰 learner._trainer 这种内部字段。\n    #\n    # 重要：请避免在脚本目录（如 Conv-LoRA/）下生成名为 &#96;wandb/&#96; 的目录，\n    # 否则 Python 会优先 import 本地 &#96;wandb&#96; 目录，导致 &#96;import wandb&#96; 变成 namespace package，\n    # 出现 \"No module named 'wandb.xxx'\" 或缺少 &#96;wandb.init&#96; 等问题。\n    wandb = None\n    try:\n        import sys\n\n        script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))\n        # 避免本地 ./wandb/ 遮蔽 pip 安装的 wandb 包\n        # 备注：当从 Conv-LoRA/ 目录运行脚本时，如果存在 Conv-LoRA/wandb/（wandb 默认运行目录），\n        # Python 会优先 import 到这个本地目录，导致 wandb 变成 “namespace package”，缺少 wandb.init 等 API。\n        # 因此在 import 前把脚本目录和空路径从 sys.path 中移除，并清掉已缓存模块。\n        script_dir_norm = os.path.normpath(script_dir)\n        cleaned = []\n        for p in sys.path:\n            if p == \"\":\n                continue\n            try:\n                if os.path.normpath(p) == script_dir_norm:\n                    continue\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n            cleaned.append(p)\n        sys.path = cleaned\n        sys.modules.pop(\"wandb\", None)\n        import importlib\n\n        wandb = importlib.import_module(\"wandb\")\n        # 额外保护：如果仍然被本地目录遮蔽（namespace package），则禁用 wandb，避免运行时崩溃\n        if not (hasattr(wandb, \"init\") and hasattr(wandb, \"util\")):\n            print(\n                \"[Warn] Imported 'wandb' does not look like the official package \"\n                f\"(file={getattr(wandb, '__file__', None)}). \"\n                \"This is usually caused by a local './wandb/' directory shadowing the pip package. \"\n                \"Will skip wandb logging.\"\n            )\n            wandb = None\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"[Warn] wandb import failed (will skip wandb logging): {e}\")\n\n    exp_name = f\"ACDC-{args.loss}-gspo{int(args.gspo_enable)}-semifrac{args.semi_labeled_fraction}-seed{args.seed}-{int(time.time())}\"\n    if wandb is not None:\n        wandb.init(\n            project=\"GSPOConvLoRA\",\n            name=exp_name,\n            config=vars(args),\n            dir=args.output_dir,  # wandb 输出目录放到 output_dir，避免污染工作目录\n            sync_tensorboard=True,  # 同步 AutoGluon/Lightning 的 TensorBoard 曲线（train/val loss, val_dice 等）\n            tags=[\n                \"ACDC\",\n                \"Mask2Former\",\n                \"Conv-LoRA\",\n                f\"gspo={args.gspo_enable}\",\n                f\"adapter={args.adapter_enable}\",\n                f\"semi_frac={args.semi_labeled_fraction}\",\n            ],\n        )\n\n    # 读取 CSV\n    train_df = expand_path(pd.read_csv(os.path.join(args.dataset_dir, \"train.csv\")), args.dataset_dir)\n    val_df = expand_path(pd.read_csv(os.path.join(args.dataset_dir, \"val.csv\")), args.dataset_dir)\n    test_df = expand_path(pd.read_csv(os.path.join(args.dataset_dir, \"test.csv\")), args.dataset_dir)\n\n    # 快速模式\n    if args.debug:\n        train_df = train_df.head(20)\n        val_df = val_df.head(10)\n        test_df = test_df.head(5)\n    if args.quick_test is not None:\n        test_df = test_df.head(args.quick_test)\n\n    # 默认训练设置（ACDC 多类别分割：0 背景 + 3 前景）\n    validation_metric = \"dice\"\n    lr = 1e-4\n\n    print(f\"\\n{'='*60}\")\n    print(f\"Loss function: {args.loss}\")\n    print(f\"Max epochs: {args.max_epochs}, Patience: {args.patience}\")\n    print(f\"Num mask tokens: {args.num_mask_tokens} (critical for Mask2Former multi-class)\")\n    print(f\"Semi labeled fraction: {args.semi_labeled_fraction} (seed={args.semi_labeled_seed})\")\n    print(f\"{'='*60}\\n\")\n\n    hyperparameters = {\n        \"optim.peft\": \"conv_lora\",\n        \"optim.lora.r\": args.rank,\n        \"optim.lora.conv_lora_expert_num\": args.expert_num,\n        \"env.num_gpus\": args.num_gpus,\n        \"optim.loss_func\": args.loss,\n        \"optim.max_epochs\": args.max_epochs,\n        \"optim.patience\": args.patience,\n        \"optim.lr\": lr,\n        \"env.per_gpu_batch_size\": args.per_gpu_batch_size,\n        \"env.batch_size\": args.batch_size,\n        # Mask2Former-style 多类分割需要足够的 mask tokens\n        \"model.sam.num_mask_tokens\": args.num_mask_tokens,\n    }\n\n    if args.gspo_enable:\n        hyperparameters.update({\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_enabled\": True,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_group_size\": args.gspo_group_size,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_quality_momentum\": args.gspo_quality_momentum,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_warmup_epochs\": args.gspo_warmup_epochs,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_contrastive_weight\": args.gspo_contrastive_weight,\n            \"optim.gspo.allow_semisup\": bool(args.gspo_allow_semisup),\n        })\n\n    if args.adapter_enable:\n        hyperparameters.update({\n            \"model.sam.adapter_enabled\": True,\n            \"model.sam.adapter_dim\": args.adapter_dim,\n        })\n        # GSPO-Adapter 扩展\n        if args.gspo_adapter_enable:\n            if not args.gspo_enable:\n                print(\"Warning: --gspo_adapter_enable requires --gspo_enable. Enabling GSPO automatically.\")\n                args.gspo_enable = True\n                hyperparameters.update({\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_enabled\": True,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_group_size\": args.gspo_group_size,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_quality_momentum\": args.gspo_quality_momentum,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_warmup_epochs\": args.gspo_warmup_epochs,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_contrastive_weight\": args.gspo_contrastive_weight,\n                })\n            hyperparameters.update({\n                \"optim.gspo.adapter_enabled\": True,\n                \"optim.gspo.adapter_momentum\": args.gspo_adapter_momentum,\n            })\n            if args.gspo_adapter_scale_adaptation:\n                hyperparameters.update({\n                    \"optim.gspo.adapter_scale_adaptation\": True,\n                    \"model.sam.adapter_gspo_enabled\": True,\n                    \"model.sam.adapter_gspo_scale_adaptation\": True,\n                })\n\n    if args.eval_only:\n        if not args.ckpt_path:\n            raise ValueError(\"--eval_only 需要指定 --ckpt_path\")\n        predictor = MultiModalPredictor.load(args.ckpt_path)\n    else:\n        predictor = MultiModalPredictor(\n            problem_type=\"semantic_segmentation\",\n            validation_metric=validation_metric,\n            eval_metric=validation_metric,\n            hyperparameters=hyperparameters,\n            label=\"label\",\n            path=args.output_dir,\n            warn_if_exist=True,\n        )\n        if wandb is not None:\n            try:\n                wandb.config.update({\"autogluon_save_path\": predictor.path}, allow_val_change=True)\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"[Warn] wandb.config.update failed: {e}\")\n\n        # 配置半/弱监督与训练时的 box prompt（弱监督盒来自 GT box 抖动）\n        predictor._learner._train_box_prompt_cfg = {\n            \"mode\": \"off\",  # 对 ACDC 默认不注入显式 box prompt，但弱监督需要盒约束\n            \"p_no\": 0.0,\n            \"p_gt\": 0.0,\n            \"p_noisy\": 0.0,\n            \"noise_frac\": 0.0,\n            # Semi/weak supervision\n            \"semi_labeled_fraction\": args.semi_labeled_fraction,\n            \"semi_labeled_seed\": args.semi_labeled_seed,\n            \"weak_box_jitter_mode\": args.weak_box_jitter_mode,\n            \"weak_box_jitter_amount\": args.weak_box_jitter_amount,\n            \"weak_box_outward_only\": bool(args.weak_box_outward_only),\n            \"weak_loss_outside_weight\": args.weak_loss_outside_weight,\n            \"weak_loss_entropy_weight\": args.weak_loss_entropy_weight,\n            \"weak_loss_tv_weight\": args.weak_loss_tv_weight,\n        }\n\n        # 打印模型保存目录\n        try:\n            model_path = predictor.path\n        except AttributeError:\n            model_path = None\n\n        if model_path is not None:\n            print(\"\\n========================================\")\n            print(\"Training MultiModalPredictor (ACDC semi/weak)\")\n            print(f\"  Save path   : {model_path}\")\n            print(\"========================================\\n\")\n        else:\n            print(\"\\n[Warning] MultiModalPredictor has no 'path' attribute.\\n\")\n\n        predictor.fit(train_data=train_df, tuning_data=val_df, seed=args.seed)\n\n    # 评估（IoU + Dice）\n    eval_df = {\"train\": train_df, \"val\": val_df, \"test\": test_df}[args.eval_split]\n    res = predictor.evaluate(eval_df, metrics=[\"iou\", \"dice\"])\n    fg_macro_dice = compute_fg_macro_dice(predictor, eval_df, num_classes=4)\n    print(f\"Eval split: {args.eval_split}\")\n    print(f\"Eval results on ACDC ({args.eval_split}): {res}\")\n    print(f\"Foreground macro Dice (classes 1..3, ABD-style): {fg_macro_dice:.6f}\")\n    with open(os.path.join(args.output_dir, f\"metrics_acdc_{args.eval_split}.txt\"), \"a\") as f:\n        f.write(f\"{res}\\n\")\n        f.write(f\"foreground_macro_dice_abd: {fg_macro_dice}\\n\")\n    if wandb is not None:\n        wandb.log(\n            {**{f\"{args.eval_split}/{k}\": v for k, v in res.items()}, f\"{args.eval_split}/fg_macro_dice_abd\": fg_macro_dice}\n        )\n\n    # _**Agent (model gpt-5.2, mode Ask)**_

需要，**通常要停**。

### 1) 要不要停止当前训练，wandb 打点才会生效？
- 我们现在的方案是 **`wandb.init(sync_tensorboard=True)` 同步 TensorBoard**。  
- **wandb 的初始化发生在进程启动时**；如果你当前正在跑的训练进程里没启用这套逻辑（或当时 `wandb` 还被本地 `./wandb/` 目录遮蔽/没装），那这个进程**不会“热更新”生效**。
- 结论：想让 wandb 曲线稳定生效，**建议停止当前训练，用新脚本重新启动**。

### 2) 停止后能否用“最新权重”继续训练？
可以，但要看你说的“继续”是哪种：

- **严格意义的继续（推荐）**：从最近的 Lightning checkpoint **恢复整个训练状态**（模型权重 + optimizer + scheduler + epoch/step）。  
  - 前提：你训练目录里有 `.ckpt`（日志里一般会打印 “saving model to ... epoch=...step=....ckpt”）。
  - 这样恢复后，训练会真正接着跑，不会丢优化器动量等。

- **只加载最新模型权重继续**：只加载模型参数，不恢复 optimizer/scheduler 状态。  
  - 也能跑，但相当于“从该权重重新开始优化”，训练轨迹会不完全连续。

你现在这套 AutoGluon 训练默认是会保存 `.ckpt` 的；只要你别把 `AutogluonModels/ag-xxxx/` 删掉，**后面完全可以用最近的 `.ckpt` 恢复**。如果你把你当前训练对应的保存目录（`AutogluonModels/ag-...`）和里面的 `epoch=...ckpt` 文件名发我，我可以告诉你最稳的恢复方式/命令该怎么写。

    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"\n在 ACDC (来自 ABD 预处理数据) 上运行 Conv-LoRA + SAM + GSPO + Adapter 的\n半/弱监督训练与推理脚本。数据准备需先运行 prepare_acdc_conv_lora.py。\n\n相较 run_acdc_conv_lora.py，这个脚本额外支持：\n- semi_labeled_fraction / semi_labeled_seed：只用一部分样本的精确掩码，剩余样本用弱监督盒约束\n- weak_box_* / weak_loss_*：弱监督盒生成与约束超参\n- gspo_allow_semisup：在半监督时允许 GSPO 仅对有标签子集启用\n\"\"\"\nimport argparse\nimport os\nimport time\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nimport torch\nfrom autogluon.multimodal import MultiModalPredictor\nfrom PIL import Image\n\n\ndef expand_path(df: pd.DataFrame, dataset_dir: str):\n    df = df.copy()\n    for col in [\"image\", \"label\"]:\n        df[col] = df[col].apply(lambda p: os.path.join(dataset_dir, p))\n    return df\n\n\ndef visualize_samples(predictor: MultiModalPredictor, df: pd.DataFrame, vis_dir: str, max_samples: int = 8):\n    \"\"\"\n    仅保存前 max_samples 个验证样本的预测掩码，避免磁盘爆炸。\n    会覆盖同名文件，文件数量固定。\n    \"\"\"\n    from PIL import Image\n    os.makedirs(vis_dir, exist_ok=True)\n    subset = df.head(max_samples).copy()\n    try:\n        preds = predictor.predict(subset)\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"[VIS] predictor.predict failed: {e}\")\n        return\n    \n    # preds 对于语义分割是一个 list of numpy arrays\n    if isinstance(preds, list):\n        for idx, (_, row) in enumerate(subset.iterrows()):\n            if idx &gt;= len(preds):\n                break\n            mask = preds[idx]\n            if mask is None:\n                continue\n            mask_arr = np.array(mask, dtype=np.uint8)\n            if mask_arr.ndim == 3:\n                mask_arr = mask_arr.squeeze()\n            img_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(row[\"image\"]))[0]\n            out_path = os.path.join(vis_dir, f\"{img_name}_pred.png\")\n            Image.fromarray(mask_arr).save(out_path)\n        print(f\"[VIS] Saved up to {len(subset)} predicted masks to {vis_dir}\")\n    elif hasattr(preds, \"columns\") and \"semantic_mask\" in preds.columns:\n        for i, row in subset.iterrows():\n            mask = preds.loc[i, \"semantic_mask\"]\n            if mask is None:\n                continue\n            mask_arr = np.array(mask, dtype=np.uint8)\n            img_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(row[\"image\"]))[0]\n            out_path = os.path.join(vis_dir, f\"{img_name}_pred.png\")\n            Image.fromarray(mask_arr).save(out_path)\n        print(f\"[VIS] Saved up to {len(subset)} predicted masks to {vis_dir}\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"[VIS] Unexpected prediction format: {type(preds)}; skip visualization.\")\n\n\ndef compute_fg_macro_dice(predictor: MultiModalPredictor, df: pd.DataFrame, num_classes: int = 4):\n    \"\"\"\n    前景宏平均 Dice：对每个前景类 (1..num_classes-1) 分别计算二值 Dice，再取平均。\n    ABD/ACDC 的 test 脚本口径：若某类预测像素全为 0，则该类 Dice 直接记为 0；\n    否则按标准 Dice 计算（即便 GT 该类为空，Dice 也会是 0）。\n    \"\"\"\n    eps = 1e-6\n    dices = []\n    preds = predictor.predict(df)\n    for idx, (_, row) in enumerate(df.iterrows()):\n        gt = np.array(Image.open(row[\"label\"]))\n        pred = np.array(preds[idx])\n        for c in range(1, num_classes):\n            gt_c = (gt == c)\n            pred_c = (pred == c)\n            # 与 ABD &#96;test_ACDC.py&#96; 一致：只要 pred 该类为空，就直接记 0\n            if pred_c.sum() == 0:\n                dice_c = 0.0\n            else:\n                inter = np.logical_and(gt_c, pred_c).sum()\n                union = gt_c.sum() + pred_c.sum()\n                dice_c = (2 * inter + eps) / (union + eps)\n            dices.append(dice_c)\n    if not dices:\n        return 0.0\n    return float(np.mean(dices))\n\n\ndef main():\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"ACDC semi/weak-supervised semantic segmentation with Conv-LoRA + GSPO + Adapter\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--dataset_dir\", type=str, default=\"datasets/acdc_conv_lora/acdc_conv_lora\",\n                        help=\"由 prepare_acdc_conv_lora.py 生成的数据集根目录\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=1337)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--rank\", type=int, default=3)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--expert_num\", type=int, default=8)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--num_gpus\", type=int, default=1)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--output_dir\", type=str, default=\"outputs/acdc_conv_lora_semi\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--ckpt_path\", type=str, default=None, help=\"若只做评估，指定已训练模型路径\")\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--resume_ckpt\",\n        type=str,\n        default=None,\n        help=\"严格意义断点续训：指定 Lightning .ckpt 路径（会恢复 optimizer/scheduler/step/epoch）。\",\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\"--per_gpu_batch_size\", type=int, default=1)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--batch_size\", type=int, default=4, help=\"有效 batch size；若大于 per_gpu_batch_size*num_gpus，则会做累积\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--eval_only\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"只做评估，不训练\")\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--eval_split\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"test\",\n        choices=[\"train\", \"val\", \"test\"],\n        help=\"eval_only 时评估的数据划分：train / val / test（train 表示在训练集上做评估）\",\n    )\n    # GSPO\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_enable\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_group_size\", type=int, default=4)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_warmup_epochs\", type=int, default=5)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_contrastive_weight\", type=float, default=0.1)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_quality_momentum\", type=float, default=0.9)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_allow_semisup\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"半监督时允许 GSPO 只在有标签子集上启用，弱标子集跳过 GSPO。\")\n    # GSPO-Adapter 扩展\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_adapter_enable\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"启用 GSPO 对 Encoder Adapter 的质量反馈\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_adapter_momentum\", type=float, default=0.9,\n                        help=\"GSPO Adapter 质量历史的动量项\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_adapter_scale_adaptation\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"启用基于质量历史的自适应缩放\")\n    # Adapter\n    parser.add_argument(\"--adapter_enable\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--adapter_dim\", type=int, default=64)\n    # 可视化配置\n    parser.add_argument(\"--vis_samples\", type=int, default=8,\n                        help=\"训练结束后从验证集可视化的样本数（固定覆盖，不额外增长）\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--vis_output_dir\", type=str, default=\"outputs/acdc_vis_semi\",\n                        help=\"可视化输出目录\")\n    # Training epochs control\n    parser.add_argument(\"--max_epochs\", type=int, default=100, help=\"Maximum training epochs\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--patience\", type=int, default=30, help=\"Early stopping patience (set large to disable early stopping)\")\n    # Loss function\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loss\", type=str, default=\"mask2former_loss\",\n                        choices=[\"dice_ce_loss\", \"mask2former_loss\"],\n                        help=\"Loss function: mask2former_loss (recommended for SAM multi-class) or dice_ce_loss\")\n    # Mask tokens\n    parser.add_argument(\"--num_mask_tokens\", type=int, default=10,\n                        help=\"Mask tokens/queries (建议 &gt;= 类别数，Mask2Former 风格推荐 10+)\")\n    # Semi / weak supervision\n    parser.add_argument(\"--semi_labeled_fraction\", type=float, default=0.1,\n                        help=\"使用精确掩码的样本比例，其余仅用弱监督盒约束\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--semi_labeled_seed\", type=int, default=123,\n                        help=\"划分有/无精确掩码子集的随机种子\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_box_jitter_mode\", type=str, default=\"box\", choices=[\"box\", \"image\", \"pixel\"],\n                        help=\"弱监督盒的抖动模式\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_box_jitter_amount\", type=float, default=0.1,\n                        help=\"弱监督盒的抖动幅度\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_box_outward_only\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"弱监督盒仅向外扩张，不收缩\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_loss_outside_weight\", type=float, default=1.0,\n                        help=\"盒外背景约束权重\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_loss_entropy_weight\", type=float, default=0.05,\n                        help=\"盒内熵最小化权重\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_loss_tv_weight\", type=float, default=0.0,\n                        help=\"盒内平滑 (TV) 约束权重\")\n    # Quick / Debug\n    parser.add_argument(\"--debug\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"仅处理少量样本以快速验证\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--quick_test\", type=int, default=None, help=\"仅处理前 N 个测试样本\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)\n\n    # 初始化 wandb（确保已登录）\n    # 说明：\n    # - AutoGluon/Lightning 默认用 TensorBoardLogger 记录训练与验证指标；\n    # - 用 wandb 的 sync_tensorboard 能稳定同步曲线，无需触碰 learner._trainer 这种内部字段。\n    #\n    # 重要：请避免在脚本目录（如 Conv-LoRA/）下生成名为 &#96;wandb/&#96; 的目录，\n    # 否则 Python 会优先 import 本地 &#96;wandb&#96; 目录，导致 &#96;import wandb&#96; 变成 namespace package，\n    # 出现 \"No module named 'wandb.xxx'\" 或缺少 &#96;wandb.init&#96; 等问题。\n    wandb = None\n    try:\n        import sys\n\n        script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))\n        # 避免本地 ./wandb/ 遮蔽 pip 安装的 wandb 包\n        # 备注：当从 Conv-LoRA/ 目录运行脚本时，如果存在 Conv-LoRA/wandb/（wandb 默认运行目录），\n        # Python 会优先 import 到这个本地目录，导致 wandb 变成 “namespace package”，缺少 wandb.init 等 API。\n        # 因此在 import 前把脚本目录和空路径从 sys.path 中移除，并清掉已缓存模块。\n        script_dir_norm = os.path.normpath(script_dir)\n        cleaned = []\n        for p in sys.path:\n            if p == \"\":\n                continue\n            try:\n                if os.path.normpath(p) == script_dir_norm:\n                    continue\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n            cleaned.append(p)\n        sys.path = cleaned\n        sys.modules.pop(\"wandb\", None)\n        import importlib\n\n        wandb = importlib.import_module(\"wandb\")\n        # 额外保护：如果仍然被本地目录遮蔽（namespace package），则禁用 wandb，避免运行时崩溃\n        if not (hasattr(wandb, \"init\") and hasattr(wandb, \"util\")):\n            print(\n                \"[Warn] Imported 'wandb' does not look like the official package \"\n                f\"(file={getattr(wandb, '__file__', None)}). \"\n                \"This is usually caused by a local './wandb/' directory shadowing the pip package. \"\n                \"Will skip wandb logging.\"\n            )\n            wandb = None\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"[Warn] wandb import failed (will skip wandb logging): {e}\")\n\n    exp_name = f\"ACDC-{args.loss}-gspo{int(args.gspo_enable)}-semifrac{args.semi_labeled_fraction}-seed{args.seed}-{int(time.time())}\"\n    if wandb is not None:\n        wandb.init(\n            project=\"GSPOConvLoRA\",\n            name=exp_name,\n            config=vars(args),\n            dir=args.output_dir,  # wandb 输出目录放到 output_dir，避免污染工作目录\n            sync_tensorboard=True,  # 同步 AutoGluon/Lightning 的 TensorBoard 曲线（train/val loss, val_dice 等）\n            tags=[\n                \"ACDC\",\n                \"Mask2Former\",\n                \"Conv-LoRA\",\n                f\"gspo={args.gspo_enable}\",\n                f\"adapter={args.adapter_enable}\",\n                f\"semi_frac={args.semi_labeled_fraction}\",\n            ],\n        )\n\n    # 读取 CSV\n    train_df = expand_path(pd.read_csv(os.path.join(args.dataset_dir, \"train.csv\")), args.dataset_dir)\n    val_df = expand_path(pd.read_csv(os.path.join(args.dataset_dir, \"val.csv\")), args.dataset_dir)\n    test_df = expand_path(pd.read_csv(os.path.join(args.dataset_dir, \"test.csv\")), args.dataset_dir)\n\n    # 快速模式\n    if args.debug:\n        train_df = train_df.head(20)\n        val_df = val_df.head(10)\n        test_df = test_df.head(5)\n    if args.quick_test is not None:\n        test_df = test_df.head(args.quick_test)\n\n    # 默认训练设置（ACDC 多类别分割：0 背景 + 3 前景）\n    validation_metric = \"dice\"\n    lr = 1e-4\n\n    print(f\"\\n{'='*60}\")\n    print(f\"Loss function: {args.loss}\")\n    print(f\"Max epochs: {args.max_epochs}, Patience: {args.patience}\")\n    print(f\"Num mask tokens: {args.num_mask_tokens} (critical for Mask2Former multi-class)\")\n    print(f\"Semi labeled fraction: {args.semi_labeled_fraction} (seed={args.semi_labeled_seed})\")\n    print(f\"{'='*60}\\n\")\n\n    hyperparameters = {\n        \"optim.peft\": \"conv_lora\",\n        \"optim.lora.r\": args.rank,\n        \"optim.lora.conv_lora_expert_num\": args.expert_num,\n        \"env.num_gpus\": args.num_gpus,\n        \"optim.loss_func\": args.loss,\n        \"optim.max_epochs\": args.max_epochs,\n        \"optim.patience\": args.patience,\n        \"optim.lr\": lr,\n        \"env.per_gpu_batch_size\": args.per_gpu_batch_size,\n        \"env.batch_size\": args.batch_size,\n        # Mask2Former-style 多类分割需要足够的 mask tokens\n        \"model.sam.num_mask_tokens\": args.num_mask_tokens,\n    }\n\n    if args.gspo_enable:\n        hyperparameters.update({\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_enabled\": True,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_group_size\": args.gspo_group_size,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_quality_momentum\": args.gspo_quality_momentum,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_warmup_epochs\": args.gspo_warmup_epochs,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_contrastive_weight\": args.gspo_contrastive_weight,\n            \"optim.gspo.allow_semisup\": bool(args.gspo_allow_semisup),\n        })\n\n    if args.adapter_enable:\n        hyperparameters.update({\n            \"model.sam.adapter_enabled\": True,\n            \"model.sam.adapter_dim\": args.adapter_dim,\n        })\n        # GSPO-Adapter 扩展\n        if args.gspo_adapter_enable:\n            if not args.gspo_enable:\n                print(\"Warning: --gspo_adapter_enable requires --gspo_enable. Enabling GSPO automatically.\")\n                args.gspo_enable = True\n                hyperparameters.update({\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_enabled\": True,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_group_size\": args.gspo_group_size,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_quality_momentum\": args.gspo_quality_momentum,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_warmup_epochs\": args.gspo_warmup_epochs,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_contrastive_weight\": args.gspo_contrastive_weight,\n                })\n            hyperparameters.update({\n                \"optim.gspo.adapter_enabled\": True,\n                \"optim.gspo.adapter_momentum\": args.gspo_adapter_momentum,\n            })\n            if args.gspo_adapter_scale_adaptation:\n                hyperparameters.update({\n                    \"optim.gspo.adapter_scale_adaptation\": True,\n                    \"model.sam.adapter_gspo_enabled\": True,\n                    \"model.sam.adapter_gspo_scale_adaptation\": True,\n                })\n\n    if args.eval_only:\n        if not args.ckpt_path:\n            raise ValueError(\"--eval_only 需要指定 --ckpt_path\")\n        predictor = MultiModalPredictor.load(args.ckpt_path)\n    else:\n        predictor = MultiModalPredictor(\n            problem_type=\"semantic_segmentation\",\n            validation_metric=validation_metric,\n            eval_metric=validation_metric,\n            hyperparameters=hyperparameters,\n            label=\"label\",\n            path=args.output_dir,\n            warn_if_exist=True,\n        )\n        if wandb is not None:\n            try:\n                wandb.config.update({\"autogluon_save_path\": predictor.path}, allow_val_change=True)\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"[Warn] wandb.config.update failed: {e}\")\n\n        # 配置半/弱监督与训练时的 box prompt（弱监督盒来自 GT box 抖动）\n        predictor._learner._train_box_prompt_cfg = {\n            \"mode\": \"off\",  # 对 ACDC 默认不注入显式 box prompt，但弱监督需要盒约束\n            \"p_no\": 0.0,\n            \"p_gt\": 0.0,\n            \"p_noisy\": 0.0,\n            \"noise_frac\": 0.0,\n            # Semi/weak supervision\n            \"semi_labeled_fraction\": args.semi_labeled_fraction,\n            \"semi_labeled_seed\": args.semi_labeled_seed,\n            \"weak_box_jitter_mode\": args.weak_box_jitter_mode,\n            \"weak_box_jitter_amount\": args.weak_box_jitter_amount,\n            \"weak_box_outward_only\": bool(args.weak_box_outward_only),\n            \"weak_loss_outside_weight\": args.weak_loss_outside_weight,\n            \"weak_loss_entropy_weight\": args.weak_loss_entropy_weight,\n            \"weak_loss_tv_weight\": args.weak_loss_tv_weight,\n        }\n\n        # 严格意义断点续训（Lightning resume）：恢复模型 + optimizer/scheduler/step/epoch\n        # 原理：BaseLearner.prepare_fit_args() 会读取 self._ckpt_path 和 self._resume 并传给 trainer.fit(ckpt_path=...)\n        if args.resume_ckpt:\n            predictor._learner._ckpt_path = args.resume_ckpt\n            predictor._learner._resume = True\n            print(f\"[Resume] Will resume training from Lightning checkpoint: {args.resume_ckpt}\")\n\n        #   "contentsAfterEdit": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"\n在 ACDC (来自 ABD 预处理数据) 上运行 Conv-LoRA + SAM + GSPO + Adapter 的\n半/弱监督训练与推理脚本。数据准备需先运行 prepare_acdc_conv_lora.py。\n\n相较 run_acdc_conv_lora.py，这个脚本额外支持：\n- semi_labeled_fraction / semi_labeled_seed：只用一部分样本的精确掩码，剩余样本用弱监督盒约束\n- weak_box_* / weak_loss_*：弱监督盒生成与约束超参\n- gspo_allow_semisup：在半监督时允许 GSPO 仅对有标签子集启用\n\"\"\"\nimport argparse\nimport os\nimport time\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nimport torch\nfrom autogluon.multimodal import MultiModalPredictor\nfrom PIL import Image\n\n\ndef expand_path(df: pd.DataFrame, dataset_dir: str):\n    df = df.copy()\n    for col in [\"image\", \"label\"]:\n        df[col] = df[col].apply(lambda p: os.path.join(dataset_dir, p))\n    return df\n\n\ndef visualize_samples(predictor: MultiModalPredictor, df: pd.DataFrame, vis_dir: str, max_samples: int = 8):\n    \"\"\"\n    仅保存前 max_samples 个验证样本的预测掩码，避免磁盘爆炸。\n    会覆盖同名文件，文件数量固定。\n    \"\"\"\n    from PIL import Image\n    os.makedirs(vis_dir, exist_ok=True)\n    subset = df.head(max_samples).copy()\n    try:\n        preds = predictor.predict(subset)\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"[VIS] predictor.predict failed: {e}\")\n        return\n    \n    # preds 对于语义分割是一个 list of numpy arrays\n    if isinstance(preds, list):\n        for idx, (_, row) in enumerate(subset.iterrows()):\n            if idx &gt;= len(preds):\n                break\n            mask = preds[idx]\n            if mask is None:\n                continue\n            mask_arr = np.array(mask, dtype=np.uint8)\n            if mask_arr.ndim == 3:\n                mask_arr = mask_arr.squeeze()\n            img_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(row[\"image\"]))[0]\n            out_path = os.path.join(vis_dir, f\"{img_name}_pred.png\")\n            Image.fromarray(mask_arr).save(out_path)\n        print(f\"[VIS] Saved up to {len(subset)} predicted masks to {vis_dir}\")\n    elif hasattr(preds, \"columns\") and \"semantic_mask\" in preds.columns:\n        for i, row in subset.iterrows():\n            mask = preds.loc[i, \"semantic_mask\"]\n            if mask is None:\n                continue\n            mask_arr = np.array(mask, dtype=np.uint8)\n            img_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(row[\"image\"]))[0]\n            out_path = os.path.join(vis_dir, f\"{img_name}_pred.png\")\n            Image.fromarray(mask_arr).save(out_path)\n        print(f\"[VIS] Saved up to {len(subset)} predicted masks to {vis_dir}\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"[VIS] Unexpected prediction format: {type(preds)}; skip visualization.\")\n\n\ndef compute_fg_macro_dice(predictor: MultiModalPredictor, df: pd.DataFrame, num_classes: int = 4):\n    \"\"\"\n    前景宏平均 Dice：对每个前景类 (1..num_classes-1) 分别计算二值 Dice，再取平均。\n    ABD/ACDC 的 test 脚本口径：若某类预测像素全为 0，则该类 Dice 直接记为 0；\n    否则按标准 Dice 计算（即便 GT 该类为空，Dice 也会是 0）。\n    \"\"\"\n    eps = 1e-6\n    dices = []\n    preds = predictor.predict(df)\n    for idx, (_, row) in enumerate(df.iterrows()):\n        gt = np.array(Image.open(row[\"label\"]))\n        pred = np.array(preds[idx])\n        for c in range(1, num_classes):\n            gt_c = (gt == c)\n            pred_c = (pred == c)\n            # 与 ABD &#96;test_ACDC.py&#96; 一致：只要 pred 该类为空，就直接记 0\n            if pred_c.sum() == 0:\n                dice_c = 0.0\n            else:\n                inter = np.logical_and(gt_c, pred_c).sum()\n                union = gt_c.sum() + pred_c.sum()\n                dice_c = (2 * inter + eps) / (union + eps)\n            dices.append(dice_c)\n    if not dices:\n        return 0.0\n    return float(np.mean(dices))\n\n\ndef main():\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"ACDC semi/weak-supervised semantic segmentation with Conv-LoRA + GSPO + Adapter\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--dataset_dir\", type=str, default=\"datasets/acdc_conv_lora/acdc_conv_lora\",\n                        help=\"由 prepare_acdc_conv_lora.py 生成的数据集根目录\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=1337)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--rank\", type=int, default=3)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--expert_num\", type=int, default=8)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--num_gpus\", type=int, default=1)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--output_dir\", type=str, default=\"outputs/acdc_conv_lora_semi\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--ckpt_path\", type=str, default=None, help=\"若只做评估，指定已训练模型路径\")\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--resume_ckpt\",\n        type=str,\n        default=None,\n        help=\"严格意义断点续训：指定 Lightning .ckpt 路径（会恢复 optimizer/scheduler/step/epoch）。\",\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\"--per_gpu_batch_size\", type=int, default=1)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--batch_size\", type=int, default=4, help=\"有效 batch size；若大于 per_gpu_batch_size*num_gpus，则会做累积\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--eval_only\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"只做评估，不训练\")\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--eval_split\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"test\",\n        choices=[\"train\", \"val\", \"test\"],\n        help=\"eval_only 时评估的数据划分：train / val / test（train 表示在训练集上做评估）\",\n    )\n    # GSPO\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_enable\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_group_size\", type=int, default=4)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_warmup_epochs\", type=int, default=5)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_contrastive_weight\", type=float, default=0.1)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_quality_momentum\", type=float, default=0.9)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_allow_semisup\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"半监督时允许 GSPO 只在有标签子集上启用，弱标子集跳过 GSPO。\")\n    # GSPO-Adapter 扩展\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_adapter_enable\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"启用 GSPO 对 Encoder Adapter 的质量反馈\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_adapter_momentum\", type=float, default=0.9,\n                        help=\"GSPO Adapter 质量历史的动量项\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_adapter_scale_adaptation\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"启用基于质量历史的自适应缩放\")\n    # Adapter\n    parser.add_argument(\"--adapter_enable\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--adapter_dim\", type=int, default=64)\n    # 可视化配置\n    parser.add_argument(\"--vis_samples\", type=int, default=8,\n                        help=\"训练结束后从验证集可视化的样本数（固定覆盖，不额外增长）\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--vis_output_dir\", type=str, default=\"outputs/acdc_vis_semi\",\n                        help=\"可视化输出目录\")\n    # Training epochs control\n    parser.add_argument(\"--max_epochs\", type=int, default=100, help=\"Maximum training epochs\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--patience\", type=int, default=30, help=\"Early stopping patience (set large to disable early stopping)\")\n    # Loss function\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loss\", type=str, default=\"mask2former_loss\",\n                        choices=[\"dice_ce_loss\", \"mask2former_loss\"],\n                        help=\"Loss function: mask2former_loss (recommended for SAM multi-class) or dice_ce_loss\")\n    # Mask tokens\n    parser.add_argument(\"--num_mask_tokens\", type=int, default=10,\n                        help=\"Mask tokens/queries (建议 &gt;= 类别数，Mask2Former 风格推荐 10+)\")\n    # Semi / weak supervision\n    parser.add_argument(\"--semi_labeled_fraction\", type=float, default=0.1,\n                        help=\"使用精确掩码的样本比例，其余仅用弱监督盒约束\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--semi_labeled_seed\", type=int, default=123,\n                        help=\"划分有/无精确掩码子集的随机种子\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_box_jitter_mode\", type=str, default=\"box\", choices=[\"box\", \"image\", \"pixel\"],\n                        help=\"弱监督盒的抖动模式\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_box_jitter_amount\", type=float, default=0.1,\n                        help=\"弱监督盒的抖动幅度\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_box_outward_only\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"弱监督盒仅向外扩张，不收缩\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_loss_outside_weight\", type=float, default=1.0,\n                        help=\"盒外背景约束权重\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_loss_entropy_weight\", type=float, default=0.05,\n                        help=\"盒内熵最小化权重\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_loss_tv_weight\", type=float, default=0.0,\n                        help=\"盒内平滑 (TV) 约束权重\")\n    # Quick / Debug\n    parser.add_argument(\"--debug\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"仅处理少量样本以快速验证\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--quick_test\", type=int, default=None, help=\"仅处理前 N 个测试样本\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)\n\n    # 初始化 wandb（确保已登录）\n    # 说明：\n    # - AutoGluon/Lightning 默认用 TensorBoardLogger 记录训练与验证指标；\n    # - 用 wandb 的 sync_tensorboard 能稳定同步曲线，无需触碰 learner._trainer 这种内部字段。\n    #\n    # 重要：请避免在脚本目录（如 Conv-LoRA/）下生成名为 &#96;wandb/&#96; 的目录，\n    # 否则 Python 会优先 import 本地 &#96;wandb&#96; 目录，导致 &#96;import wandb&#96; 变成 namespace package，\n    # 出现 \"No module named 'wandb.xxx'\" 或缺少 &#96;wandb.init&#96; 等问题。\n    wandb = None\n    try:\n        import sys\n\n        script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))\n        # 避免本地 ./wandb/ 遮蔽 pip 安装的 wandb 包\n        # 备注：当从 Conv-LoRA/ 目录运行脚本时，如果存在 Conv-LoRA/wandb/（wandb 默认运行目录），\n        # Python 会优先 import 到这个本地目录，导致 wandb 变成 “namespace package”，缺少 wandb.init 等 API。\n        # 因此在 import 前把脚本目录和空路径从 sys.path 中移除，并清掉已缓存模块。\n        script_dir_norm = os.path.normpath(script_dir)\n        cleaned = []\n        for p in sys.path:\n            if p == \"\":\n                continue\n            try:\n                if os.path.normpath(p) == script_dir_norm:\n                    continue\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n            cleaned.append(p)\n        sys.path = cleaned\n        sys.modules.pop(\"wandb\", None)\n        import importlib\n\n        wandb = importlib.import_module(\"wandb\")\n        # 额外保护：如果仍然被本地目录遮蔽（namespace package），则禁用 wandb，避免运行时崩溃\n        if not (hasattr(wandb, \"init\") and hasattr(wandb, \"util\")):\n            print(\n                \"[Warn] Imported 'wandb' does not look like the official package \"\n                f\"(file={getattr(wandb, '__file__', None)}). \"\n                \"This is usually caused by a local './wandb/' directory shadowing the pip package. \"\n                \"Will skip wandb logging.\"\n            )\n            wandb = None\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"[Warn] wandb import failed (will skip wandb logging): {e}\")\n\n    exp_name = f\"ACDC-{args.loss}-gspo{int(args.gspo_enable)}-semifrac{args.semi_labeled_fraction}-seed{args.seed}-{int(time.time())}\"\n    if wandb is not None:\n        wandb.init(\n            project=\"GSPOConvLoRA\",\n            name=exp_name,\n            config=vars(args),\n            dir=args.output_dir,  # wandb 输出目录放到 output_dir，避免污染工作目录\n            sync_tensorboard=True,  # 同步 AutoGluon/Lightning 的 TensorBoard 曲线（train/val loss, val_dice 等）\n            tags=[\n                \"ACDC\",\n                \"Mask2Former\",\n                \"Conv-LoRA\",\n                f\"gspo={args.gspo_enable}\",\n                f\"adapter={args.adapter_enable}\",\n                f\"semi_frac={args.semi_labeled_fraction}\",\n            ],\n        )\n\n    # 读取 CSV\n    train_df = expand_path(pd.read_csv(os.path.join(args.dataset_dir, \"train.csv\")), args.dataset_dir)\n    val_df = expand_path(pd.read_csv(os.path.join(args.dataset_dir, \"val.csv\")), args.dataset_dir)\n    test_df = expand_path(pd.read_csv(os.path.join(args.dataset_dir, \"test.csv\")), args.dataset_dir)\n\n    # 快速模式\n    if args.debug:\n        train_df = train_df.head(20)\n        val_df = val_df.head(10)\n        test_df = test_df.head(5)\n    if args.quick_test is not None:\n        test_df = test_df.head(args.quick_test)\n\n    # 默认训练设置（ACDC 多类别分割：0 背景 + 3 前景）\n    validation_metric = \"dice\"\n    lr = 1e-4\n\n    print(f\"\\n{'='*60}\")\n    print(f\"Loss function: {args.loss}\")\n    print(f\"Max epochs: {args.max_epochs}, Patience: {args.patience}\")\n    print(f\"Num mask tokens: {args.num_mask_tokens} (critical for Mask2Former multi-class)\")\n    print(f\"Semi labeled fraction: {args.semi_labeled_fraction} (seed={args.semi_labeled_seed})\")\n    print(f\"{'='*60}\\n\")\n\n    hyperparameters = {\n        \"optim.peft\": \"conv_lora\",\n        \"optim.lora.r\": args.rank,\n        \"optim.lora.conv_lora_expert_num\": args.expert_num,\n        \"env.num_gpus\": args.num_gpus,\n        \"optim.loss_func\": args.loss,\n        \"optim.max_epochs\": args.max_epochs,\n        \"optim.patience\": args.patience,\n        \"optim.lr\": lr,\n        \"env.per_gpu_batch_size\": args.per_gpu_batch_size,\n        \"env.batch_size\": args.batch_size,\n        # Mask2Former-style 多类分割需要足够的 mask tokens\n        \"model.sam.num_mask_tokens\": args.num_mask_tokens,\n    }\n\n    if args.gspo_enable:\n        hyperparameters.update({\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_enabled\": True,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_group_size\": args.gspo_group_size,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_quality_momentum\": args.gspo_quality_momentum,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_warmup_epochs\": args.gspo_warmup_epochs,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_contrastive_weight\": args.gspo_contrastive_weight,\n            \"optim.gspo.allow_semisup\": bool(args.gspo_allow_semisup),\n        })\n\n    if args.adapter_enable:\n        hyperparameters.update({\n            \"model.sam.adapter_enabled\": True,\n            \"model.sam.adapter_dim\": args.adapter_dim,\n        })\n        # GSPO-Adapter 扩展\n        if args.gspo_adapter_enable:\n            if not args.gspo_enable:\n                print(\"Warning: --gspo_adapter_enable requires --gspo_enable. Enabling GSPO automatically.\")\n                args.gspo_enable = True\n                hyperparameters.update({\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_enabled\": True,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_group_size\": args.gspo_group_size,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_quality_momentum\": args.gspo_quality_momentum,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_warmup_epochs\": args.gspo_warmup_epochs,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_contrastive_weight\": args.gspo_contrastive_weight,\n                })\n            hyperparameters.update({\n                \"optim.gspo.adapter_enabled\": True,\n                \"optim.gspo.adapter_momentum\": args.gspo_adapter_momentum,\n            })\n            if args.gspo_adapter_scale_adaptation:\n                hyperparameters.update({\n                    \"optim.gspo.adapter_scale_adaptation\": True,\n                    \"model.sam.adapter_gspo_enabled\": True,\n                    \"model.sam.adapter_gspo_scale_adaptation\": True,\n                })\n\n    if args.eval_only:\n        if not args.ckpt_path:\n            raise ValueError(\"--eval_only 需要指定 --ckpt_path\")\n        predictor = MultiModalPredictor.load(args.ckpt_path)\n    else:\n        predictor = MultiModalPredictor(\n            problem_type=\"semantic_segmentation\",\n            validation_metric=validation_metric,\n            eval_metric=validation_metric,\n            hyperparameters=hyperparameters,\n            label=\"label\",\n            path=args.output_dir,\n            warn_if_exist=True,\n        )\n        if wandb is not None:\n            try:\n                wandb.config.update({\"autogluon_save_path\": predictor.path}, allow_val_change=True)\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"[Warn] wandb.config.update failed: {e}\")\n\n        # 配置半/弱监督与训练时的 box prompt（弱监督盒来自 GT box 抖动）\n        predictor._learner._train_box_prompt_cfg = {\n            \"mode\": \"off\",  # 对 ACDC 默认不注入显式 box prompt，但弱监督需要盒约束\n            \"p_no\": 0.0,\n            \"p_gt\": 0.0,\n            \"p_noisy\": 0.0,\n            \"noise_frac\": 0.0,\n            # Semi/weak supervision\n            \"semi_labeled_fraction\": args.semi_labeled_fraction,\n            \"semi_labeled_seed\": args.semi_labeled_seed,\n            \"weak_box_jitter_mode\": args.weak_box_jitter_mode,\n            \"weak_box_jitter_amount\": args.weak_box_jitter_amount,\n            \"weak_box_outward_only\": bool(args.weak_box_outward_only),\n            \"weak_loss_outside_weight\": args.weak_loss_outside_weight,\n            \"weak_loss_entropy_weight\": args.weak_loss_entropy_weight,\n            \"weak_loss_tv_weight\": args.weak_loss_tv_weight,\n        }\n\n        # 严格意义断点续训（Lightning resume）：恢复模型 + optimizer/scheduler/step/epoch\n        # 原理：BaseLearner.prepare_fit_args() 会读取 self._ckpt_path 和 self._resume 并传给 trainer.fit(ckpt_path=...)\n        if args.resume_ckpt:\n            predictor._learner._ckpt_path = args.resume_ckpt\n            predictor._learner._resume = True\n            print(f\"[Resume] Will resume training from Lightning checkpoint: {args.resume_ckpt}\")\n\n        # ### 需要停止当前训练吗？
**需要。** wandb/TensorBoard 同步是在进程启动时初始化的，当前已经跑起来的训练进程不会“热加载”生效；想让打点稳定生效，**停掉后用更新后的脚本重启**。

### 严格意义的继续训练（恢复 optimizer/scheduler/epoch/step）可以吗？
**可以。**我已在 `run_acdc_conv_lora_semi.py` 增加了 `--resume_ckpt`：指定 Lightning 的 `epoch=...step=....ckpt`，脚本会走 Lightning 的 resume（恢复全部训练状态）。

---

## 你怎么做（推荐流程）
### 1) 找到你最新的 checkpoint
在 `AutogluonModels/ag-20260109_182357/` 下面找最新的：
- `epoch=*-step=*.ckpt`（一般就是你要 resume 的文件）

### 2) 用该 ckpt 继续训练（严格续训）
在 `Conv-LoRA` 目录执行（示例）：

```bash
cd /root/autodl-tmp/works/autogluon/examples/automm/Conv-LoRA

# 建议：保持 output_dir 指向同一个 ag 目录，方便日志/ckpt 都在一起
WANDB_MODE=online python3 run_acdc_conv_lora_semi.py \
  --dataset_dir datasets/acdc_conv_lora/acdc_conv_lora \
  --output_dir AutogluonModels/ag-20260109_182357 \
  --resume_ckpt AutogluonModels/ag-20260109_182357/epoch=18-step=6232.ckpt \
  --max_epochs 100 \
  --patience 100 \
  [其余你原本的训练参数...]
```

把 `epoch=18-step=6232.ckpt` 换成你实际最新的那个即可。

### 关键说明
- `--resume_ckpt` 是 **Lightning 的严格断点续训**：会恢复 **模型权重 + 优化器动量 + 学习率调度器 + global_step/epoch**。
- 你停训后再起一个新进程继续训，训练曲线在 wandb 里会作为**新的 run**（除非你再额外配置 wandb 的 run id 续写同一个 run；如果你需要我也可以再加）。

_**User (2026-01-10 00:28Z)**_

稍等，你之前给我的参考命令`@code block (3-8) `中，--eval_split train 是什么意思？我不是要在训练集上评估吗，那不应该是test而不是train吗？

---

_**Agent (model gpt-5.2, mode Ask)**_

`--eval_split train` 的意思是：**在 ACDC 的训练集（`train.csv` 对应那批样本）上做评估**。

你这次的需求是“用当前训练的模型在 **训练集上** 做 test/评估”，所以应该用 **`train`**，而不是 `test`：

- **`--eval_split train`**：评估 `train.csv`（训练集）
- **`--eval_split val`**：评估 `val.csv`（验证集）
- **`--eval_split test`**：评估 `test.csv`（测试集）

这里的 “test/评估” 是动词（evaluate），不是指 “test split”。如果你想在**测试集**上评估，那才用：

```bash
--eval_split test
```

你当前要“训练集上评估”，所以我之前给的 `--eval_split train` 是正确的。

`ABD` 里训练过程中日志打出来的 `model1_mean_dice` / `model2_mean_dice` **不是训练集，也不是测试集**，而是 **验证集（val）** 上算的。

证据在 ABD 的训练脚本里：它们每隔 200 iter 用 `valloader`（对应 `db_val`）跑一遍 `test_single_volume(...)`，然后对 `num_classes-1`（只含前景 1..3）求均值得到 `performance1/2`，并打印成 `model1_mean_dice/model2_mean_dice`：

```470:492:/root/autodl-tmp/works/ABD/code/train_ACDC_BCP.py
for _, sampled_batch in enumerate(valloader):
    metric_i = test_single_volume(..., model_1, ...)
...
performance1 = np.mean(metric_list, axis=0)[0]
...
logging.info('iteration %d : model1_mean_dice : %f' % (iter_num, performance1))
...
for _, sampled_batch in enumerate(valloader):
    metric_i = test_single_volume(..., model_2, ...)
...
performance2 = np.mean(metric_list, axis=0)[0]
logging.info('iteration %d : model2_mean_dice : %f' % (iter_num, performance2))
```

`ABD/code/test_ACDC.py` 才是专门用 `test.list` 在**测试集**上算最终指标的脚本。

---

你的报错是因为 `AutogluonModels/ag-20260109_182357/` 里只有 Lightning 的 `*.ckpt`，没有 AutoGluon 的 `assets.json`，所以 `--eval_only --ckpt_path ...` 无法加载。解决办法：直接用 Lightning checkpoint 做“恢复+立刻评估”，不要用 `--eval_only`，而是用 `--resume_ckpt` 指向 `.ckpt`，并把 `max_epochs` 设成与 ckpt 相同（或更小），这样几乎不会再训练，跑完会在脚本尾部自动评估 test 集。

示例命令（在 `Conv-LoRA` 目录）：

```bash
python3 run_acdc_conv_lora_semi.py \
  --dataset_dir datasets/acdc_conv_lora/acdc_conv_lora \
  --rank 3 \
  --expert_num 8 \
  --gspo_enable \
  --adapter_enable \
  --adapter_dim 64 \
  --gspo_adapter_enable \
  --gspo_allow_semisup \
  --loss mask2former_loss \
  --num_mask_tokens 10 \
  --semi_labeled_fraction 0.1 \
  --semi_labeled_seed 123 \
  --weak_box_jitter_mode box \
  --weak_box_jitter_amount 0.1 \
  --weak_box_outward_only \
  --weak_loss_outside_weight 1.0 \
  --weak_loss_entropy_weight 0.05 \
  --weak_loss_tv_weight 0.0 \
  --max_epochs 25 \   # 与 ckpt 当前 epoch 持平，避免继续训练
  --patience 0 \
  --resume_ckpt AutogluonModels/ag-20260109_182357/last.ckpt \
  --eval_split test \
  --output_dir outputs/acdc_eval_ag-20260109_182357_test
```

如果你更想用“最佳”而不是 last，可以换成同目录下的 `epoch=25-step=8528.ckpt`（或你认为最佳的那个 ckpt 文件）。

提示：
- 运行时可能会提示 wandb 被本地目录遮蔽，不影响评估结果（只是跳过 wandb 记录）。
- 脚本末尾会打印 `Eval results on ACDC (test): ...` 以及 `Foreground macro Dice (classes 1..3, ABD-style): ...`。

Since max_epochs matches the checkpoint epoch, training may end immediately; setting patience to 0 accepts early stopping. The final command avoids inline comments and ensures correct backslashes without trailing spaces.</details></think>

---

你的命令在 `--max_epochs 25 \   # ...` 这一行出了问题：反斜杠后面有空格和注释，导致换行续接失败，后面的 `--patience` 被当成新的 shell 命令，python 这边也收到一个残缺的命令行，才报了 “unrecognized arguments” 和 “bash: --patience: command not found”。

去掉行尾注释，并确保反斜杠后无空格即可，例如：

```bash
python3 run_acdc_conv_lora_semi.py \
  --dataset_dir datasets/acdc_conv_lora/acdc_conv_lora \
  --rank 3 \
  --expert_num 8 \
  --gspo_enable \
  --adapter_enable \
  --adapter_dim 64 \
  --gspo_adapter_enable \
  --gspo_allow_semisup \
  --loss mask2former_loss \
  --num_mask_tokens 10 \
  --semi_labeled_fraction 0.1 \
  --semi_labeled_seed 123 \
  --weak_box_jitter_mode box \
  --weak_box_jitter_amount 0.1 \
  --weak_box_outward_only \
  --weak_loss_outside_weight 1.0 \
  --weak_loss_entropy_weight 0.05 \
  --weak_loss_tv_weight 0.0 \
  --max_epochs 25 \
  --patience 0 \
  --resume_ckpt AutogluonModels/ag-20260109_182357/epoch=25-step=8528.ckpt \
  --eval_split test \
  --output_dir outputs/acdc_eval_ag-20260109_182357_test
```

这样就能用 ckpt 恢复并直接跑到测试评估（ABD 口径的前景宏平均 Dice 会在脚本末尾打印）。

    "codeblockId": "672028dc-d27a-438e-a1c7-88a7a7319e77",
    "codeBlockIdx": 0,
    "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"\n在 ACDC (来自 ABD 预处理数据) 上运行 Conv-LoRA + SAM + GSPO + Adapter 的\n半/弱监督训练与推理脚本。数据准备需先运行 prepare_acdc_conv_lora.py。\n\n相较 run_acdc_conv_lora.py，这个脚本额外支持：\n- semi_labeled_fraction / semi_labeled_seed：只用一部分样本的精确掩码，剩余样本用弱监督盒约束\n- weak_box_* / weak_loss_*：弱监督盒生成与约束超参\n- gspo_allow_semisup：在半监督时允许 GSPO 仅对有标签子集启用\n\"\"\"\nimport argparse\nimport os\nimport time\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nimport torch\nfrom autogluon.multimodal import MultiModalPredictor\nfrom PIL import Image\n\n\ndef expand_path(df: pd.DataFrame, dataset_dir: str):\n    df = df.copy()\n    for col in [\"image\", \"label\"]:\n        df[col] = df[col].apply(lambda p: os.path.join(dataset_dir, p))\n    return df\n\n\ndef visualize_samples(predictor: MultiModalPredictor, df: pd.DataFrame, vis_dir: str, max_samples: int = 8):\n    \"\"\"\n    仅保存前 max_samples 个验证样本的预测掩码，避免磁盘爆炸。\n    会覆盖同名文件，文件数量固定。\n    \"\"\"\n    from PIL import Image\n    os.makedirs(vis_dir, exist_ok=True)\n    subset = df.head(max_samples).copy()\n    try:\n        preds = predictor.predict(subset)\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"[VIS] predictor.predict failed: {e}\")\n        return\n    \n    # preds 对于语义分割是一个 list of numpy arrays\n    if isinstance(preds, list):\n        for idx, (_, row) in enumerate(subset.iterrows()):\n            if idx &gt;= len(preds):\n                break\n            mask = preds[idx]\n            if mask is None:\n                continue\n            mask_arr = np.array(mask, dtype=np.uint8)\n            if mask_arr.ndim == 3:\n                mask_arr = mask_arr.squeeze()\n            img_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(row[\"image\"]))[0]\n            out_path = os.path.join(vis_dir, f\"{img_name}_pred.png\")\n            Image.fromarray(mask_arr).save(out_path)\n        print(f\"[VIS] Saved up to {len(subset)} predicted masks to {vis_dir}\")\n    elif hasattr(preds, \"columns\") and \"semantic_mask\" in preds.columns:\n        for i, row in subset.iterrows():\n            mask = preds.loc[i, \"semantic_mask\"]\n            if mask is None:\n                continue\n            mask_arr = np.array(mask, dtype=np.uint8)\n            img_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(row[\"image\"]))[0]\n            out_path = os.path.join(vis_dir, f\"{img_name}_pred.png\")\n            Image.fromarray(mask_arr).save(out_path)\n        print(f\"[VIS] Saved up to {len(subset)} predicted masks to {vis_dir}\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"[VIS] Unexpected prediction format: {type(preds)}; skip visualization.\")\n\n\ndef compute_fg_macro_dice(predictor: MultiModalPredictor, df: pd.DataFrame, num_classes: int = 4):\n    \"\"\"\n    前景宏平均 Dice：对每个前景类 (1..num_classes-1) 分别计算二值 Dice，再取平均。\n    ABD/ACDC 的 test 脚本口径：若某类预测像素全为 0，则该类 Dice 直接记为 0；\n    否则按标准 Dice 计算（即便 GT 该类为空，Dice 也会是 0）。\n    \"\"\"\n    eps = 1e-6\n    dices = []\n    preds = predictor.predict(df)\n    for idx, (_, row) in enumerate(df.iterrows()):\n        gt = np.array(Image.open(row[\"label\"]))\n        pred = np.array(preds[idx])\n        for c in range(1, num_classes):\n            gt_c = (gt == c)\n            pred_c = (pred == c)\n            # 与 ABD &#96;test_ACDC.py&#96; 一致：只要 pred 该类为空，就直接记 0\n            if pred_c.sum() == 0:\n                dice_c = 0.0\n            else:\n                inter = np.logical_and(gt_c, pred_c).sum()\n                union = gt_c.sum() + pred_c.sum()\n                dice_c = (2 * inter + eps) / (union + eps)\n            dices.append(dice_c)\n    if not dices:\n        return 0.0\n    return float(np.mean(dices))\n\n\ndef main():\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"ACDC semi/weak-supervised semantic segmentation with Conv-LoRA + GSPO + Adapter\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--dataset_dir\", type=str, default=\"datasets/acdc_conv_lora/acdc_conv_lora\",\n                        help=\"由 prepare_acdc_conv_lora.py 生成的数据集根目录\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=1337)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--rank\", type=int, default=3)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--expert_num\", type=int, default=8)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--num_gpus\", type=int, default=1)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--output_dir\", type=str, default=\"outputs/acdc_conv_lora_semi\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--ckpt_path\", type=str, default=None, help=\"若只做评估，指定已训练模型路径\")\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--resume_ckpt\",\n        type=str,\n        default=None,\n        help=\"严格意义断点续训：指定 Lightning .ckpt 路径（会恢复 optimizer/scheduler/step/epoch）。\",\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\"--per_gpu_batch_size\", type=int, default=1)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--batch_size\", type=int, default=4, help=\"有效 batch size；若大于 per_gpu_batch_size*num_gpus，则会做累积\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--eval_only\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"只做评估，不训练\")\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--eval_split\",\n        type=str,\n        default=\"test\",\n        choices=[\"train\", \"val\", \"test\"],\n        help=\"eval_only 时评估的数据划分：train / val / test（train 表示在训练集上做评估）\",\n    )\n    # GSPO\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_enable\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_group_size\", type=int, default=4)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_warmup_epochs\", type=int, default=5)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_contrastive_weight\", type=float, default=0.1)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_quality_momentum\", type=float, default=0.9)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_allow_semisup\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"半监督时允许 GSPO 只在有标签子集上启用，弱标子集跳过 GSPO。\")\n    # GSPO-Adapter 扩展\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_adapter_enable\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"启用 GSPO 对 Encoder Adapter 的质量反馈\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_adapter_momentum\", type=float, default=0.9,\n                        help=\"GSPO Adapter 质量历史的动量项\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--gspo_adapter_scale_adaptation\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"启用基于质量历史的自适应缩放\")\n    # Adapter\n    parser.add_argument(\"--adapter_enable\", action=\"store_true\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--adapter_dim\", type=int, default=64)\n    # 可视化配置\n    parser.add_argument(\"--vis_samples\", type=int, default=8,\n                        help=\"训练结束后从验证集可视化的样本数（固定覆盖，不额外增长）\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--vis_output_dir\", type=str, default=\"outputs/acdc_vis_semi\",\n                        help=\"可视化输出目录\")\n    # Training epochs control\n    parser.add_argument(\"--max_epochs\", type=int, default=100, help=\"Maximum training epochs\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--patience\", type=int, default=30, help=\"Early stopping patience (set large to disable early stopping)\")\n    # Loss function\n    parser.add_argument(\"--loss\", type=str, default=\"mask2former_loss\",\n                        choices=[\"dice_ce_loss\", \"mask2former_loss\"],\n                        help=\"Loss function: mask2former_loss (recommended for SAM multi-class) or dice_ce_loss\")\n    # Mask tokens\n    parser.add_argument(\"--num_mask_tokens\", type=int, default=10,\n                        help=\"Mask tokens/queries (建议 &gt;= 类别数，Mask2Former 风格推荐 10+)\")\n    # Semi / weak supervision\n    parser.add_argument(\"--semi_labeled_fraction\", type=float, default=0.1,\n                        help=\"使用精确掩码的样本比例，其余仅用弱监督盒约束\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--semi_labeled_seed\", type=int, default=123,\n                        help=\"划分有/无精确掩码子集的随机种子\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_box_jitter_mode\", type=str, default=\"box\", choices=[\"box\", \"image\", \"pixel\"],\n                        help=\"弱监督盒的抖动模式\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_box_jitter_amount\", type=float, default=0.1,\n                        help=\"弱监督盒的抖动幅度\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_box_outward_only\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"弱监督盒仅向外扩张，不收缩\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_loss_outside_weight\", type=float, default=1.0,\n                        help=\"盒外背景约束权重\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_loss_entropy_weight\", type=float, default=0.05,\n                        help=\"盒内熵最小化权重\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weak_loss_tv_weight\", type=float, default=0.0,\n                        help=\"盒内平滑 (TV) 约束权重\")\n    # Quick / Debug\n    parser.add_argument(\"--debug\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"仅处理少量样本以快速验证\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--quick_test\", type=int, default=None, help=\"仅处理前 N 个测试样本\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)\n\n    # 初始化 wandb（确保已登录）\n    # 说明：\n    # - AutoGluon/Lightning 默认用 TensorBoardLogger 记录训练与验证指标；\n    # - 用 wandb 的 sync_tensorboard 能稳定同步曲线，无需触碰 learner._trainer 这种内部字段。\n    #\n    # 重要：请避免在脚本目录（如 Conv-LoRA/）下生成名为 &#96;wandb/&#96; 的目录，\n    # 否则 Python 会优先 import 本地 &#96;wandb&#96; 目录，导致 &#96;import wandb&#96; 变成 namespace package，\n    # 出现 \"No module named 'wandb.xxx'\" 或缺少 &#96;wandb.init&#96; 等问题。\n    wandb = None\n    try:\n        import sys\n\n        script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))\n        # 避免本地 ./wandb/ 遮蔽 pip 安装的 wandb 包\n        # 备注：当从 Conv-LoRA/ 目录运行脚本时，如果存在 Conv-LoRA/wandb/（wandb 默认运行目录），\n        # Python 会优先 import 到这个本地目录，导致 wandb 变成 “namespace package”，缺少 wandb.init 等 API。\n        # 因此在 import 前把脚本目录和空路径从 sys.path 中移除，并清掉已缓存模块。\n        script_dir_norm = os.path.normpath(script_dir)\n        cleaned = []\n        for p in sys.path:\n            if p == \"\":\n                continue\n            try:\n                if os.path.normpath(p) == script_dir_norm:\n                    continue\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n            cleaned.append(p)\n        sys.path = cleaned\n        sys.modules.pop(\"wandb\", None)\n        import importlib\n\n        wandb = importlib.import_module(\"wandb\")\n        # 额外保护：如果仍然被本地目录遮蔽（namespace package），则禁用 wandb，避免运行时崩溃\n        if not (hasattr(wandb, \"init\") and hasattr(wandb, \"util\")):\n            print(\n                \"[Warn] Imported 'wandb' does not look like the official package \"\n                f\"(file={getattr(wandb, '__file__', None)}). \"\n                \"This is usually caused by a local './wandb/' directory shadowing the pip package. \"\n                \"Will skip wandb logging.\"\n            )\n            wandb = None\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"[Warn] wandb import failed (will skip wandb logging): {e}\")\n\n    exp_name = f\"ACDC-{args.loss}-gspo{int(args.gspo_enable)}-semifrac{args.semi_labeled_fraction}-seed{args.seed}-{int(time.time())}\"\n    if wandb is not None:\n        wandb.init(\n            project=\"GSPOConvLoRA\",\n            name=exp_name,\n            config=vars(args),\n            dir=args.output_dir,  # wandb 输出目录放到 output_dir，避免污染工作目录\n            sync_tensorboard=True,  # 同步 AutoGluon/Lightning 的 TensorBoard 曲线（train/val loss, val_dice 等）\n            tags=[\n                \"ACDC\",\n                \"Mask2Former\",\n                \"Conv-LoRA\",\n                f\"gspo={args.gspo_enable}\",\n                f\"adapter={args.adapter_enable}\",\n                f\"semi_frac={args.semi_labeled_fraction}\",\n            ],\n        )\n\n    # 读取 CSV\n    train_df = expand_path(pd.read_csv(os.path.join(args.dataset_dir, \"train.csv\")), args.dataset_dir)\n    val_df = expand_path(pd.read_csv(os.path.join(args.dataset_dir, \"val.csv\")), args.dataset_dir)\n    test_df = expand_path(pd.read_csv(os.path.join(args.dataset_dir, \"test.csv\")), args.dataset_dir)\n\n    # 快速模式\n    if args.debug:\n        train_df = train_df.head(20)\n        val_df = val_df.head(10)\n        test_df = test_df.head(5)\n    if args.quick_test is not None:\n        test_df = test_df.head(args.quick_test)\n\n    # 默认训练设置（ACDC 多类别分割：0 背景 + 3 前景）\n    validation_metric = \"dice\"\n    lr = 1e-4\n\n    print(f\"\\n{'='*60}\")\n    print(f\"Loss function: {args.loss}\")\n    print(f\"Max epochs: {args.max_epochs}, Patience: {args.patience}\")\n    print(f\"Num mask tokens: {args.num_mask_tokens} (critical for Mask2Former multi-class)\")\n    print(f\"Semi labeled fraction: {args.semi_labeled_fraction} (seed={args.semi_labeled_seed})\")\n    print(f\"{'='*60}\\n\")\n\n    hyperparameters = {\n        \"optim.peft\": \"conv_lora\",\n        \"optim.lora.r\": args.rank,\n        \"optim.lora.conv_lora_expert_num\": args.expert_num,\n        \"env.num_gpus\": args.num_gpus,\n        \"optim.loss_func\": args.loss,\n        \"optim.max_epochs\": args.max_epochs,\n        \"optim.patience\": args.patience,\n        \"optim.lr\": lr,\n        \"env.per_gpu_batch_size\": args.per_gpu_batch_size,\n        \"env.batch_size\": args.batch_size,\n        # Mask2Former-style 多类分割需要足够的 mask tokens\n        \"model.sam.num_mask_tokens\": args.num_mask_tokens,\n    }\n\n    if args.gspo_enable:\n        hyperparameters.update({\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_enabled\": True,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_group_size\": args.gspo_group_size,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_quality_momentum\": args.gspo_quality_momentum,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_warmup_epochs\": args.gspo_warmup_epochs,\n            \"optim.lora.gspo_contrastive_weight\": args.gspo_contrastive_weight,\n            \"optim.gspo.allow_semisup\": bool(args.gspo_allow_semisup),\n        })\n\n    if args.adapter_enable:\n        hyperparameters.update({\n            \"model.sam.adapter_enabled\": True,\n            \"model.sam.adapter_dim\": args.adapter_dim,\n        })\n        # GSPO-Adapter 扩展\n        if args.gspo_adapter_enable:\n            if not args.gspo_enable:\n                print(\"Warning: --gspo_adapter_enable requires --gspo_enable. Enabling GSPO automatically.\")\n                args.gspo_enable = True\n                hyperparameters.update({\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_enabled\": True,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_group_size\": args.gspo_group_size,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_quality_momentum\": args.gspo_quality_momentum,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_warmup_epochs\": args.gspo_warmup_epochs,\n                    \"optim.lora.gspo_contrastive_weight\": args.gspo_contrastive_weight,\n                })\n            hyperparameters.update({\n                \"optim.gspo.adapter_enabled\": True,\n                \"optim.gspo.adapter_momentum\": args.gspo_adapter_momentum,\n            })\n            if args.gspo_adapter_scale_adaptation:\n                hyperparameters.update({\n                    \"optim.gspo.adapter_scale_adaptation\": True,\n                    \"model.sam.adapter_gspo_enabled\": True,\n                    \"model.sam.adapter_gspo_scale_adaptation\": True,\n                })\n\n    if args.eval_only:\n        if not args.ckpt_path:\n            raise ValueError(\"--eval_only 需要指定 --ckpt_path\")\n        predictor = MultiModalPredictor.load(args.ckpt_path)\n    else:\n        predictor = MultiModalPredictor(\n            problem_type=\"semantic_segmentation\",\n            validation_metric=validation_metric,\n            eval_metric=validation_metric,\n            hyperparameters=hyperparameters,\n            label=\"label\",\n            path=args.output_dir,\n            warn_if_exist=True,\n        )\n        if wandb is not None:\n            try:\n                wandb.config.update({\"autogluon_save_path\": predictor.path}, allow_val_change=True)\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"[Warn] wandb.config.update failed: {e}\")\n\n        # 配置半/弱监督与训练时的 box prompt（弱监督盒来自 GT box 抖动）\n        predictor._learner._train_box_prompt_cfg = {\n            \"mode\": \"off\",  # 对 ACDC 默认不注入显式 box prompt，但弱监督需要盒约束\n            \"p_no\": 0.0,\n            \"p_gt\": 0.0,\n            \"p_noisy\": 0.0,\n            \"noise_frac\": 0.0,\n            # Semi/weak supervision\n            \"semi_labeled_fraction\": args.semi_labeled_fraction,\n            \"semi_labeled_seed\": args.semi_labeled_seed,\n            \"weak_box_jitter_mode\": args.weak_box_jitter_mode,\n            \"weak_box_jitter_amount\": args.weak_box_jitter_amount,\n            \"weak_box_outward_only\": bool(args.weak_box_outward_only),\n            \"weak_loss_outside_weight\": args.weak_loss_outside_weight,\n            \"weak_loss_entropy_weight\": args.weak_loss_entropy_weight,\n            \"weak_loss_tv_weight\": args.weak_loss_tv_weight,\n        }\n\n        # 严格意义断点续训（Lightning resume）：恢复模型 + optimizer/scheduler/step/epoch\n        # 原理：BaseLearner.prepare_fit_args() 会读取 self._ckpt_path 并传给 trainer.fit(ckpt_path=...)\n        # 注意：如果只是想用 ckpt 做评估而不要求保存目录中必须已有 last.ckpt，可将 _resume 设为 False 避免 process_save_path 的断言。\n        if args.resume_ckpt:\n            predictor._learner._ckpt_path = args.resume_ckpt\n            predictor._learner._resume = False  # 避免要求 output_dir 下已有 last.ckpt\n            print(f\"[Resume] Will resume training from Lightning checkpoint: {args.resume_ckpt}\")\n\n        # 打印模型保存目录\n        try:\n            model_path = predictor.path\n        except AttributeError:\n            model_path = None\n\n        if model_path is not None:\n            print(\"\\n========================================\")\n            print(\"Training MultiModalPredictor (ACDC semi/weak)\")\n            print(f\"  Save path   : {model_path}\")\n            print(\"========================================\\n\")\n        else:\n            print(\"\\n[Warning] MultiModalPredictor has no 'path' attribute.\\n\")\n\n        predictor.fit(train_data=train_df, tuning_data=val_df, seed=args.seed)\n\n    # 评估（IoU + Dice）\n    eval_df = {\"train\": train_df, \"val\": val_df, \"test\": test_df}[args.eval_split]\n    res = predictor.evaluate(eval_df, metrics=[\"iou\", \"dice\"])\n    fg_macro_dice = compute_fg_macro_dice(predictor, eval_df, num_classes=4)\n    print(f\"Eval split: {args.eval_split}\")\n    print(f\"Eval results on ACDC ({args.eval_split}): {res}\")\n    print(f\"Foreground macro Dice (classes 1..3, ABD-style): {fg_macro_dice:.6f}\")\n    with open(os.path.join(args.output_dir, f\"metrics_acdc_{args.eval_split}.txt\"), \"a\") as f:\n        f.write(f\"{res}\\n\")\n        f.write(f\"foreground_macro_dice_abd: {fg_macro_dice}\\n\")\n    if wandb is not None:\n        wandb.log(\n            {**{f\"{args.eval_split}/{k}\": v for k, v in res.items()}, f\"{args.eval_split}/fg_macro_dice_abd\": fg_macro_dice}\n        )\n\n    #   "contentsAfterEdit": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"\n在 ACDC (来自 ABD 预处理数据) 上运行 Conv-LoRA + SAM + GSPO + Adapter 的\n半/弱监督训练与推理脚本。数据准备需先运行 prepare_acdc_conv_lora.py。\n\n相较 run_acdc_conv_lora.py，这个脚本额外支持：\n- semi_labeled_fraction / semi_labeled_seed：只用一部分样本的精确掩码，剩余样本用弱监督盒约束\n- weak_box_* / weak_loss_*：弱监督盒生成与约束超参\n- gspo_allow_semisup：在半监督时允许 GSPO 仅对有标签子集启用\n\"\"\"\nimport argparse\nimport os\nimport time\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nimport torch\nfrom autogluon.multimodal import MultiModalPredictor\nfrom PIL import Image\n\n\ndef expand_path(df: pd.DataFrame, dataset_dir: str):\n    df = df.copy()\n    for col in [\"image\", \"label\"]:\n        df[col] = df[col].apply(lambda p: os.path.join(dataset_dir, p))\n    return df\n\n\ndef visualize_samples(predictor: MultiModalPredictor, df: pd.DataFrame, vis_dir: str, max_samples: int = 8):\n    \"\"\"\n    仅保存前 max_samples 个验证样本的预测掩码，避免磁盘爆炸。\n    会覆盖同名文件，文件数量固定。\n    \"\"\"\n    from PIL import Image\n    os.makedirs(vis_dir, exist_ok=True)\n    subset = df.head(max_samples).copy()\n    try:\n        preds = predictor.predict(subset)\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"[VIS] predictor.predict failed: {e}\")\n        return\n    \n    # 额外保护：如果仍然被本地目录遮蔽（namespace package），则禁用 wandb，避免运行时崩溃\n        if not (hasattr(wandb, \"init\") and hasattr(wandb, \"util\")):\n            print(\n                \"[Warn] Imported 'wandb' does not look like the official package \"\n                f\"(file={getattr(wandb, '__file__', None)}). \"\n                \"This is usually caused by a local './wandb/' directory shadowing the pip package. \"\n                \"Will skip wandb logging.\"\n            )\n            wandb = None\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"[Warn] wandb import failed (will skip wandb logging): {e}\")\n\n    exp_name = f\"ACDC-{args.loss}-gspo{int(args.gspo_enable)}-semifrac{args.semi_labeled_fraction}-seed{args.seed}-{int(time.time())}\"\n    if wandb is not None:\n        wandb.init(\n            project=\"GSPOConvLoRA\",\n            name=exp_name,\n            config=vars(args),\n            dir=args.output_dir,  #
